watch_outs: MHIC Contractor Licensing: Maryland requires Home Improvement Commission licensing Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) licenses all contractors—verify at dllr.state.md.us. License numbers must appear on contracts. Reddit users appreciate the complaint process.

DC Suburb Costs: Montgomery and Prince George Labor costs in the DC suburbs are 30-40% above national average. Reddit warns that low bids often mean unlicensed workers. Permit requirements are extensive.

Humidity & Moisture Control: Maryland High humidity from May through September causes mold and moisture issues. Reddit emphasizes proper ventilation, dehumidification, and moisture-resistant materials.

Chesapeake Bay Coastal Issues: Eastern Shore and Bay properties face flood and storm surge risk Coastal Maryland deals with flooding, storm surge, and rising sea levels. FEMA flood zone status affects insurance and renovation requirements.

Historic Preservation: Maryland has extensive historic districts with strict requirements Annapolis, Baltimore neighborhoods, and many other areas have historic commissions. Exterior changes require approval. Reddit recommends checking before planning work.
